name: Kaede Ageha
source:
She is one of the top national idols of today and is well known in her class.

As beautiful and cute as she looks, her girlish and modest personality makes her very popular not only among her friends but also among young girls.

Every time she meets with the protagonist, a slight misunderstanding happens which leads to a roundhouse kick and a verbal altercation. She is not very good at expressing her feelings, and has a habit of being blunt.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/saimin/index.html]official site[/url]]
